verdict.rationale: Skyvern documents a first-party self-hosted mode that runs entirely on your own servers, browsers, and LLM keys, so data location follows wherever you deploy it. That gives effective control over residency, but nothing shows region selection or residency guarantees in Skyvern Cloud. Missing for 10: cloud region or residency selection, documented data-residency or storage-location commitments for the hosted service, independent corroboration.
